title: Strategy’s STRC stock crashes to $95 despite promise of 44 years of dividends
summary: Strategy's (formerly MicroStrategy) STRC preferred stock plunged to its lowest level since August on Wednesday despite the company's multibillion-dollar repurchase campaign. The Michael Saylor-led company's preferred shares fell to $95.51 before recovering to $96.16, according to Strategy's data.
